event_id_policy: Permanent archive IDs are independent of season/card numbers.
source: Split from legacy archive/crypto-history/events.json without renumbering or dropping records.

events.title: Ethereum mainnet launches

research.summary: Ethereum's Frontier genesis launched on 30 July 2015, bringing the first live Ethereum mainnet into operation.
research.significance: This was the birth of the programmable smart-contract network that would underpin ICOs, DeFi, NFTs, DAOs and much of later crypto culture.

events.title: MakerDAO project begins

research.summary: MakerDAO traces its founding to late 2014, with active development of code, architecture and documentation underway from 2015; Rune Christensen described the eDollar precursor in March 2015.
research.significance: Maker became one of Ethereum's foundational DeFi projects and ultimately created Dai, a decentralized stablecoin.
research.notes: Raw 2015 label captures active development, but founding is better dated to late 2014.

events.title: Bitstamp suffers a major hot-wallet breach

research.summary: Bitstamp said operational wallets were compromised on 4 January 2015, resulting in the loss of less than 19,000 BTC; services were temporarily suspended and later rebuilt.
research.significance: It was a major post-Mt.Gox exchange-security test and reinforced the importance of cold storage and operational compartmentalization.

events.title: US CFTC treats Bitcoin and other virtual currencies as commodities in enforcement

research.summary: In the Coinflip enforcement action, the CFTC formally held for the first time that Bitcoin and other virtual currencies are commodities under the Commodity Exchange Act.
research.significance: The ruling established a central pillar of US federal commodities regulation for crypto derivatives.

sources.title: CFTC — Coinflip order recognizes virtual currencies as commodities

events.title: Ross Ulbricht receives a life sentence in the Silk Road case

research.summary: Ross Ulbricht was sentenced to life in federal prison after being convicted on all seven counts arising from his operation of Silk Road.
research.significance: The sentence became one of the most consequential criminal-justice events in Bitcoin's early history and fueled a long-running clemency campaign.

sources.title: US DOJ — Ross Ulbricht sentenced to life

events.title: Augur becomes an early Ethereum prediction-market project

research.summary: Augur was one of the earliest Ethereum prediction-market projects and conducted a REP crowdsale during the pre-mainnet/early-mainnet era.
research.significance: Historically important as an early decentralized oracle/prediction-market design, but this broad row needs an exact launch source before full verification.

events.title: New York introduces BitLicense

research.summary: New York's Department of Financial Services made its virtual-currency regulation, commonly called the BitLicense, effective on 24 June 2015.
research.significance: BitLicense became one of the earliest comprehensive state-level crypto licensing regimes and influenced where firms would or would not serve customers.

sources.title: NYDFS — Virtual Currency Business Licensing timeline

events.title: Spells of Genesis develops blockchain gaming collectibles

research.summary: Spells of Genesis developed blockchain-linked in-game collectibles using Counterparty-era assets.
research.significance: It is an important pre-CryptoKitties gaming/NFT precursor, but the row needs an exact card/token launch milestone before scoring.

events.title: Mark Karpeles is arrested in Japan over Mt. Gox-related charges

research.summary: Former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpeles was arrested in Japan on 1 August 2015, not 2014.
research.significance: The arrest was part of the legal aftermath of Mt. Gox and should sit in the 2015 timeline.

sources.title: The Guardian — Mark Karpeles arrested in Japan

events.title: Ethereum Frontier miners begin securing smart-contract mainnet

research.summary: Frontier launched with miners and nodes securing Ethereum's first live network.
research.significance: Mining/security context of the canonical Ethereum mainnet launch.

events.title: Augur crowdsale becomes an early Ethereum token sale

research.summary: Augur conducted an early token crowdsale for REP.
research.significance: Potential ICO-history milestone, but exact opening/closing dates and amount raised need a reliable archived Augur source before canonical scoring.

events.title: BitLicense takes effect in New York

research.summary: This is the same BitLicense effective-date milestone as LORE-EVT-0281.

significance.title: NYDFS — Virtual Currency Business Licensing timeline

events.title: Coinbase secures major venture funding from traditional finance investors

research.summary: Coinbase announced a $75 million Series C led by DFJ Growth with participation from NYSE, USAA and BBVA among others.
research.significance: The round was then the largest funding round for a Bitcoin company and one of the first major direct investments by established financial institutions into a crypto business.

events.title: 21 Inc raises a massive Bitcoin startup funding round

research.summary: Bitcoin hardware startup 21 Inc announced an unusually large financing round and became one of the best-funded Bitcoin startups of the era.
research.significance: Strong venture-history context, but amount/date require authoritative sourcing before verification.

events.title: Colored Coins experimentation influences later NFT and token ideas

research.summary: Colored Coins experiments on Bitcoin explored representing non-BTC assets in transaction metadata and influenced later token and NFT concepts.
research.significance: This is an intellectual/technical lineage rather than a single 2015 event.

sources.title: Blockstream — Enabling Blockchain Innovations with Pegged Sidechains

research.notes: Keep as context; replace with a specific Colored Coins paper/release if card consideration requires an event.

events.title: Dash rebrands from Darkcoin

research.summary: Darkcoin rebranded to Dash in 2015 after earlier names XCoin and Darkcoin.
research.significance: The rebrand shifted positioning from explicit privacy branding toward broader digital cash/payments.

events.title: Ross Ulbricht's Silk Road trial results in conviction

research.summary: A federal jury found Ross Ulbricht guilty on all seven counts after a four-week Silk Road trial; sentencing followed in May.
research.significance: The conviction preceded the life sentence and closed the central criminal trial phase of the original Silk Road case.

sources.title: US DOJ — Ross Ulbricht sentenced to life

events.title: US Marshals continue auctioning Silk Road Bitcoin

research.summary: The US Marshals Service held additional auctions of Silk Road-related Bitcoin after the first 2014 sale.
research.significance: Use individual auction dates and quantities rather than one broad row if this survives card selection.

events.title: Coinbase opens first regulated Bitcoin exchange in multiple US states

research.summary: Coinbase launched Coinbase Exchange, describing it as the first regulated US Bitcoin exchange, initially available in 24 states or territories.
research.significance: It marked a significant shift toward regulated domestic exchange infrastructure in the United States.

sources.title: Coinbase — Launches First Regulated Bitcoin Exchange in US

events.title: Nasdaq begins blockchain experiments for private markets

research.summary: Nasdaq announced an enterprise blockchain initiative, initially applying Open Assets/colored-coin technology to its private-market equity infrastructure; Nasdaq Linq clients were announced later that year.
research.significance: A major stock-exchange operator publicly experimenting with blockchain signaled institutional interest beyond cryptocurrency trading.

events.title: R3 consortium forms around bank blockchain experimentation

research.summary: Nine major banks joined R3 in September 2015 to develop common distributed-ledger frameworks; R3's own later history describes an earlier 2014 formation phase.
research.significance: The bank consortium became one of the defining institutional-blockchain experiments of the mid-2010s.

sources.title: Reuters — nine banks join R3 blockchain partnership

research.notes: Keep distinction between R3 corporate origins and September 2015 bank-consortium announcement.

events.title: Linux Foundation launches Hyperledger project

research.summary: The Linux Foundation launched the Hyperledger collaborative blockchain effort in December 2015.
research.significance: Hyperledger institutionalized open-source enterprise distributed-ledger development outside permissionless cryptocurrency networks.

events.title: OpenBazaar beta develops decentralized marketplace ideas

research.summary: OpenBazaar beta development advanced a peer-to-peer marketplace without a central operator.
research.significance: The full public launch is a cleaner 2016 event; this 2015 beta row needs exact archived release evidence.

events.title: Liquid sidechain development begins

research.summary: Blockstream announced Liquid, its first production sidechain project, with exchange and brokerage launch partners.
research.significance: Liquid became a major Bitcoin federated sidechain for faster settlement and asset issuance.

events.title: Hashnest and hosted mining products expand

research.summary: Hosted and cloud-mining services expanded as ASIC mining became capital-intensive.
research.significance: Trend rather than discrete event; needs provider-specific milestone if retained.
